$comment: Guided usability test script. Each task is a goal, not a click path: the facilitator reads the instruction, the participant uses the UI, and success is judged against the criterion. Shared by scripts/usability-guided.py and the /usability page.

tasks.title: Read the project pulse
tasks.instruction: Open the dashboard. Find the Project pulse card and read the headline, the three scores, and the number of pending decisions.
tasks.success: You can state the headline and the security / stalls / tunnel scores.

tasks.title: Find a session
tasks.instruction: In Search, type 'session' and open the first result (or read its title and cost).
tasks.success: A search result appears and you can name the session you found.

tasks.title: Select and inspect a graph node
tasks.instruction: Open Graph. Select any node (click, or Tab to the canvas then press n) and read its side panel.
tasks.success: The side panel shows the node id/type and at least one real field.

tasks.title: Open stall signals
tasks.instruction: Open Explore, choose the signals tab, and find the session-health panel.
tasks.success: The signals pane is visible and you can name a finding or say there are none.

tasks.title: Find a host-only procedure
tasks.instruction: Open Runbooks, filter to host only, and open one procedure.
tasks.success: A host procedure is visible and you can name it.

tasks.title: Check the model policy
tasks.instruction: Open Models and find the ALLOW / ASK / BLOCK verdict for the current model.
tasks.success: You can name the current model and its verdict.

tasks.title: Read a rule
tasks.instruction: Open Docs, select RULES.md, and find the substitution for the blacklist.
tasks.success: The rule text is visible and you can name one substitution.
